tools.name: discover_provider
tools.description: FREE DISCOVERY. Returns provider identity, commerce model, payment rails, policy, and next actions before payment.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: FREE DISCOVERY. Lists free and paid capabilities with access and charging metadata.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: FREE DISCOVERY. Searches public offer metadata before payment.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: FREE QUALIFICATION. Returns enough information to evaluate one offer before paying.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: FREE QUALIFICATION. Returns advertised USD price or request-credit cost without charging.

tools.name: preview_result_schema
tools.description: FREE QUALIFICATION. Shows expected result shape without revealing paid content.

tools.name: check_requirements
tools.description: FREE QUALIFICATION. Explains payment, authorization, fulfillment, and idempotency prerequisites.

tools.name: execution_preflight
tools.description: FREE QUALIFICATION. Final machine-readable no-charge decision point before payment or credit-consuming execution.

tools.name: list_stripe_offers
tools.description: Lists the known CrossingKey Stripe Payment Links. Digital offers report whether the exact fulfillment file has been verified on this server.

tools.name: get_stripe_checkout_link
tools.description: Returns the exact Stripe Payment Link for a known CrossingKey offer. Never invents a checkout URL.

tools.name: get_request_credit_links
tools.description: Returns the live Stripe Payment Links for prepaid CrossingKey request credits.

tools.name: get_fulfillment_status
tools.description: Checks whether a Stripe offer has a verified delivery file bound to this server.

tools.name: list_request_services
tools.description: Lists request services approved after the safe-file scan. Empty until services are explicitly approved.

tools.name: crossingkey.describe
tools.description: FREE. Describes the receiver-only CrossingKey machine-commerce service and its safety boundaries.

tools.name: capabilities.list
tools.description: FREE. Lists deterministic paid machine-commerce capabilities without executing them.

tools.name: capability.get
tools.description: FREE. Returns one deterministic capability definition and exact advertised price.

tools.name: capability.quote
tools.description: FREE. Returns x402 v1 and v2 challenge requirements for one capability without executing or settling payment.

tools.name: payment.methods
tools.description: FREE. Lists supported payment methods and explicitly reports the receiver-only wallet boundary.

tools.name: purchase.status
tools.description: FREE STATUS. Returns the state of a machine-commerce purchase by its idempotency key without revealing paid result content.

tools.name: entitlement.inspect
tools.description: FREE STATUS. Inspects entitlement state by identifier without granting execution or result access.

tools.name: fulfillment.status
tools.description: FREE STATUS. Returns fulfillment state and result hash by purchase idempotency key.

tools.name: fulfillment.get
tools.description: FREE STATUS. Returns fulfillment identifiers and integrity binding but does not disclose paid result content.

tools.name: receipt.verify
tools.description: FREE. Recomputes the deterministic result hash embedded in a CrossingKey receipt.

tools.name: health
tools.description: FREE. Returns local service readiness flags and the mainnet safety-gate state.

tools.name: payment.verify_onchain
tools.description: FREE READ-ONLY. Independently verifies a CrossingKey Base mainnet USDC transfer using Base JSON-RPC and optionally reconciles an existing receipt.

tools.name: xkey_validate_intake
tools.description: Paid bounded intake validation. Costs 1 prepaid credit on verified success. Safe validation failures release the reserved credit.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_requirements" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: FREE QUALIFICATION. Explains payment, authorization, fulfillment, and idempotency prerequisites.
